blocks.content: Assistant can write queries across your observability stack. Describe what you want and use an at-mention to point Assistant at a specific data source.

whenTrue.content: If this guide is docked in the sidebar, pop it out into a floating window so it stays visible beside **Assistant**.

blocks.content: To generate a query from a prompt, complete the following steps:

blocks.title: Generate a query from a prompt

blocks.content: If the Assistant panel is closed, open **Assistant** from the top toolbar.

In the chat input, type the at symbol (@) and pick a data source from the mention list, then ask for a query.

For metrics:

> Create a PromQL query in @prometheus-ds that shows p95 latency for checkout_service over the last hour.

For logs:

> Find logs from @loki-logs where job="checkout" and level="error" in the last 15 minutes.

Replace those example names with data sources in your stack.

Review the generated query and, when data is available, any visualization or Explore view Assistant opens.

Treat the result as a draft. You refine it in a later milestone.

You practiced turning a natural-language request into a query draft.

For supported sources and more examples, refer to [Query data](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/querying/).

whenTrue.content: Dock this guide back to the sidebar when you are ready for the next milestone.

blocks.content: In the next milestone, you'll paste an existing query and ask Assistant to explain it.
